files.content:
# Acme Robotics

## Overview
Acme Robotics builds warehouse picking robots and sells them as a monthly service to mid-sized retailers in Europe. It employs about 400 people and is privately held.

## News
- 12 Sep 2026: raised a €60M Series C led by a Nordic pension fund.
- 3 Sep 2026: signed a three-year contract with a German grocery chain for 40 sites.

## Risks
- Customer concentration: its two largest customers are about half of revenue.
- Being private, it publishes no audited accounts, so revenue figures come from press releases.
